name: TMPWaveEffect
src_typeComment: Classic TMP wave: offsets each character's mesh vertices in a running sine wave every frame. Caches the "clean" (unanimated) vertex positions once whenever the text changes, instead of calling ForceMeshUpdate() every frame — that both avoids an unnecessary full re-layout each frame and, more importantly, avoids repeatedly resetting vertex colors, which would otherwise fight a TMPWordHighlighter on the same text object (ForceMeshUpdate regenerates the whole mesh, including colors).

src_serialized.name: amplitude
src_serialized.tooltip: Vertical height of the wave in local text units.

src_serialized.name: frequency
src_serialized.tooltip: Wave phase offset between adjacent characters. Higher = tighter ripples.
